tasks.label: Android: Install Debug to Device
tasks.command: ./gradlew :androidApp:assembleDebug && APK=$(find androidApp/build/outputs/apk/debug -maxdepth 1 -name '*.apk' 2>/dev/null | head -n1) && { [ -n "$APK" ] || { echo "!! 未找到 APK，构建可能失败"; exit 1; }; } && SEEN="" && adb devices | tail -n +2 | while IFS= read -r line; do d=$(echo "$line" | tr -s ' 	' '	' | cut -f1); st=$(echo "$line" | tr -s ' 	' '	' | cut -f2); [ -z "$d" ] && continue; [ "$st" = "device" ] || { echo "!! 跳过 $d (状态=$st，连接未授权/离线)"; continue; }; case ";$SEEN;" in *";$d;"*) echo ".. 跳过 $d (重复连接)"; continue;; esac; SEEN="$SEEN;$d"; echo "==> 安装到 $d"; adb -s "$d" install -r "$APK" < /dev/null || echo "!! 安装失败 $d（签名冲突请改用 Reinstall 任务）"; done

tasks.label: Android: Uninstall from all devices
tasks.command: SEEN="" && adb devices | tail -n +2 | while IFS= read -r line; do d=$(echo "$line" | tr -s ' 	' '	' | cut -f1); st=$(echo "$line" | tr -s ' 	' '	' | cut -f2); [ -z "$d" ] && continue; [ "$st" = "device" ] || { echo "!! 跳过 $d (状态=$st)"; continue; }; case ";$SEEN;" in *";$d;"*) continue;; esac; SEEN="$SEEN;$d"; echo "==> 卸载 $d"; adb -s "$d" uninstall zhiqiu.car.app < /dev/null || echo "!! 卸载失败 $d"; done

tasks.label: Android: Reinstall & Launch (all devices)
tasks.command: SEEN="" && adb devices | tail -n +2 | while IFS= read -r line; do d=$(echo "$line" | tr -s ' 	' '	' | cut -f1); st=$(echo "$line" | tr -s ' 	' '	' | cut -f2); [ -z "$d" ] && continue; [ "$st" = "device" ] || { echo "!! 跳过 $d (状态=$st)"; continue; }; case ";$SEEN;" in *";$d;"*) continue;; esac; SEEN="$SEEN;$d"; echo "==> 卸载 $d"; adb -s "$d" uninstall zhiqiu.car.app < /dev/null || true; done && JAVA_HOME=

./gradlew :androidApp:assembleDebug && APK=$(find androidApp/build/outputs/apk/debug -maxdepth 1 -name '*.apk' 2>/dev/null | head -n1) && { [ -n "$APK" ] || { echo "!! 未找到 APK"; exit 1; }; } && SEEN="" && adb devices | tail -n +2 | while IFS= read -r line; do d=$(echo "$line" | tr -s ' 	' '	' | cut -f1); st=$(echo "$line" | tr -s ' 	' '	' | cut -f2); [ -z "$d" ] && continue; [ "$st" = "device" ] || { echo "!! 跳过 $d (状态=$st)"; continue; }; case ";$SEEN;" in *";$d;"*) echo ".. 跳过 $d (重复连接)"; continue;; esac; SEEN="$SEEN;$d"; echo "==> 安装并启动 $d"; adb -s "$d" install -r "$APK" < /dev/null && adb -s "$d" shell am start -n zhiqiu.car.app/.MainActivity < /dev/null || echo "!! 安装失败 $d"; done

tasks.label: Android: Launch App on all devices (adb)
tasks.command: SEEN="" && adb devices | tail -n +2 | while IFS= read -r line; do d=$(echo "$line" | tr -s ' 	' '	' | cut -f1); st=$(echo "$line" | tr -s ' 	' '	' | cut -f2); [ -z "$d" ] && continue; [ "$st" = "device" ] || { echo "!! 跳过 $d (状态=$st)"; continue; }; case ";$SEEN;" in *";$d;"*) echo ".. 跳过 $d (重复连接)"; continue;; esac; SEEN="$SEEN;$d"; echo "==> 启动 $d"; adb -s "$d" shell am start -n zhiqiu.car.app/.MainActivity < /dev/null; done
